context: M11 o3. Royal Cafeteria. Tina picks at pie and won't look up.

lines.speaker: char.tina_mercado
lines.text: Del! Rule twelve: there is no rule twelve. I'm tired of rules.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: Rule six, then. You're two weeks behind. That's not like you.

lines.speaker: char.tina_mercado
lines.text: Family stuff. My cousin. Lawyers cost money. I'll catch up.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: Your cousin is standing at the window, Tina. Waving at me.

lines.speaker: char.lonnie_gage
lines.text: Del, baby. A bank needs a guard. I'm offering to be the guard.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: Rule seven: nobody guards my money but me. Excuse me.
